body: Another problem with this documentation: "results" is used for two different purposes on https://angular.io/guide/http, in both the JSON file and the TypeScript file.  The demos would be more clear if a name is not reused for different items.  One can figure out what when one already understands the material or by tinkering, but it is unwelcoming for explanatory material to use gratuitous ambiguity.

A version at https://plnkr.co/edit/y0rhIR3NjYToVFCXpubZ?p=preview gets much of the functionality working with HttpClientModule, but two methods in hero.service.ts are not working properly: create and update.
Here's another page that confusingly uses both: https://angular.io/guide/ngmodules

issue.title: docs: update docs to use HttpClientModule instead of HttpModule
